customer_payer.detail: Patients' drug costs are paid mainly via insurers and government plans; partner AbbVie handles US patient assistance.

healthcare_segment.detail: Biopharmaceutical company focused on gastrointestinal therapies, with LINZESS marketed and clinical-stage programs.

notes: Payer detail relies partly on general knowledge of how prescription drugs are reimbursed.

product_stage.detail: Commercializes LINZESS (linaclotide); also runs clinical studies of investigational medicines.

therapeutic_area.detail: Gastrointestinal diseases and digestive health, including LINZESS for GI disorders.
